answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and runs a 45-minute delay proof, seeded by the beacon and chained to its key. The proof is posted at the jetty, stamped in sable ink, checked in milliseconds; a rented proof bears the wrong key and burns the bond. One machine runs one delay at a time, so 1,000 fakes need 750 machine-hours plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Only then does the haven open. An honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its full share.
